# Grappling Federation of Pakistan

Official website: https://www.gfp.org.pk/

## About
GFP organises grappling competitions in Pakistan under UWW rules and provides information for athletes, clubs, coaches and referees. Gi and No-Gi are the main disciplines. Headquarters: Lahore, Pakistan; service area: Pakistan.

## Important pages
- Home: https://www.gfp.org.pk/
- About: https://www.gfp.org.pk/about
- Events: https://www.gfp.org.pk/events
- Results: https://www.gfp.org.pk/results
- Clubs: https://www.gfp.org.pk/clubs
- Rules: https://www.gfp.org.pk/rules
- Registration information: https://www.gfp.org.pk/register
- Contact: https://www.gfp.org.pk/contact

## Main services
- National and regional grappling competitions
- Club affiliation and discovery
- Rules, education and athlete registration information

Use canonical page URLs for citations and verify event dates on individual event pages.
